nl: Convert orders.json (an array of objects) to export/orders-4.csv with the columns id, customer, status in this order, a header line and one line per order, without quotes.
oracle_program: read "orders.json" |> select id customer status |> write "export/orders-4.csv" format: csv parents: true
reference_pwsh:
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force export | Out-Null
Get-Content orders.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json | Select-Object id,customer,status | ConvertTo-Csv -NoTypeInformation -UseQuotes Never | Set-Content export/orders-4.csv
